Optimized exllama quantizations of [deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731) (304B total, 6 of 256 experts active per token, 1M context).

Quantized with exllamav3 v1.4.0.

Head layer retained at full precision, attention layers across all optimized quants pinned to 4.0bpw as it is nearly free on this model — attention is 1.66% of parameters, so the boost costs ≈0.03bpw.

**Given the nature of the base model, this model does not quantize well in terms of filesize/VRAM usage.** The original is not BF16 — it is fp4-packed at 4.39 bits/param (166.9 GB), so there is far less headroom to reclaim than a 304B parameter count suggests, and fidelity is capped by the source. Nothing here fits in under 96 GB of VRAM. Above ≈4.4bpw the quant is larger than the original while still bounded by it, so run the original instead.

Additional quants can be generated by anyone using my measurement data in [measurement.json](https://huggingface.co/amanwalksdownthestreet/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731-exl3/blob/main/measurement.json) and the base quants.
